out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine. OBSERVED UNAPPROVED, INACCURATE THERMOMETER FOR THE HIGH TEMPERATURE SANITIZING DISH MACHINE READING 159F WHEN EHS THERMOMETER READ 162F.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PIC INFORMED HE NEEDS TO PURCHASE EITHER HEAT SENSITIVE TEST STRIPS, APPROVED STEM THERMOMETER FOR DISHWASHING MACHINE, OR DISH TEMPERATURE PLATE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: heavy whipping cream (45F), in #3; bacon sausage wrap (46F), egg pesto mozzarella sandwich (52F), egg bites (46F), tomato mozzarella spinach sandwich (45F), and turkey provolone pesto sandwich (45F) in #4.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the food items during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: BEVERAGE AIR 2 DR UC (49F)
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the TCS food items in the refrigeration unit and took it out of commission for repairs. The food establishment has ample refrigeration units for proper cold holding. The maintenance staff was contacted and arrived at the food establishment to assist with the equipment work order. The refrigeration unit repairs are in process. TARGET STORE T-1893 (Inspection Date: 05/07/2025) Page 2 of 3
